lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-ordered 2D arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized in roughly parallel horizontal rows across the visible mid-flank, posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal spot rows, forming a grid-like pattern on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense concentration of micro-luminance points on the anterior rostrum, transitioning into larger discrete circular blobs towards the posterior trunk.
